text: Tell me about yourself and your engineering journey so far.
Where do you want to be in your career 3 years from now, and why?
Tell me about a time you led a project that faced significant pushback from the team or stakeholders.
Describe a situation where you had to make a critical technical decision without all the information you needed.
Tell me about a time you had to influence a technical direction without having formal authority.
Describe a moment when you stepped up to lead when no one else did. What happened?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a technical decision made by a manager or senior engineer. How did you handle it?
Describe a situation where two team members had a serious disagreement. What did you do?
Tell me about a time a client or stakeholder pushed back hard on a technical recommendation. How did you respond?
Tell me about your most significant professional failure. What happened and what did you learn?
Describe a project that went badly wrong. What was your role and what would you do differently?
Tell me about a time you shipped something that broke in production. Walk me through what happened.
Tell me about the most technically challenging problem you solved in the last 12 months.
Describe a feature or system you built that you are most proud of. What made it difficult?
Tell me about a time you significantly improved the performance of a system. What was the before and after?
Describe a technical achievement you are proud of that happened under significant time pressure.
Tell me about a time you worked on a cross-functional team. How did you ensure alignment?
Describe a situation where you had to bring together people with very different working styles to ship something.
Tell me about a time a teammate was struggling. What did you do?
Tell me about a time you had to make progress on a project with very unclear requirements.
Describe a situation where the scope of your work kept changing. How did you manage it?
Tell me about a time you had to start building something before the full picture was clear.
Tell me about a time you identified a problem no one else was paying attention to and fixed it anyway.
Describe a time you proposed and drove an improvement that wasn't part of your job description.
Tell me about a time you saw a gap in your team's processes and took action to close it.
Tell me about a time you had to explain a complex technical concept to a non-technical stakeholder.
Describe a situation where miscommunication caused a real problem. How did you recover?
Tell me about a time you were under extreme pressure with a hard deadline. How did you perform?
Describe a production incident you were involved in. What was your role and how did it resolve?
Tell me about a system you designed from scratch. Walk me through your key design decisions.
Describe a time you had to redesign an existing system because it wasn't scaling. What did you change and why?
Tell me about a time you had to make a trade-off between system simplicity and scalability.
Tell me about the hardest bug you ever had to debug. How did you approach it?
Describe a time you had to debug a production issue with very little information. What was your process?
Tell me about a bug that turned out to be caused by something completely different from what you first suspected.
Tell me about a time you had to choose between two viable technical approaches. How did you decide?
Describe a situation where you pushed back on a technical requirement from a stakeholder. What happened?
Tell me about a time you chose to take on technical debt deliberately. Was it the right call?
Describe a technical decision you made that turned out to be wrong. What did you do when you realized it?
Tell me about a time you identified and fixed a serious performance bottleneck in a production system.
Describe a system you optimized. What metrics improved and how did you measure success?
Tell me about an architectural decision that had the most lasting impact on a product you worked on.
Describe a time you had to migrate from one architectural pattern to another while keeping the system running.
What engineering principle do you hold most strongly, and tell me about a time it was tested?
Describe a moment in your career where you had to choose between doing something fast and doing it right.
Tell me about a strength you have that consistently shows up in how you work with others.
Describe a piece of work that best represents what you are capable of at your best.
Tell me about a working environment where you did your best work. What made it work for you?
Describe how you structure your day when you are in the middle of a complex, multi-week project.
Tell me about something you are actively working to improve about yourself as an engineer. What triggered this?
